title: κ = 1.128922474816875e-3: twelve early-final-use bit-helper resets
body:
κ = 1.128922474816875e-3 = 1806275959707/1600000000000000

This new record candidate starts from the frozen split-centre construction in PR #433 and applies twelve source-bound early-final-use helper resets to its R=758 bit word. Each reset is an exact F2 donor identity at a legal frame after the retired helper's last use and before the replacement helper's first use. The changed word has R=746, reducing the live bit stock to 14,394 and raising the conditional assembled bound above PR #433's 0.001120864952258278. Earlier PR heads remain unchanged.

The constructor checks all twelve selected boundaries against the actual word, verifies each clean reset sum, rebuilds the dirty-response compensation from the new word, removes the replaced helper, and regenerates the inverse cleanup. The final word has SHA256 `fc5b2fb84dbbdbcf9b1bb36ebf768f31130dd5a93edec3d12f52c8e4be66ce48`.

Fresh replay evidence in the package:

- Both forward and reflected local scalar programs restore all 986 source, target and dirty-helper columns.
- All 944 exact rational frames and both paid ledgers are recomputed.
- Twelve omitted-reset controls, eleven delayed-reset controls, missing dirty compensation and missing helper cleanup are rejected; one deliberately delayed reset is a valid positive control.
- The changed global stream replays 7,674 unbanked columns, 53,712 bank-owner assignments and every reflected route, with eight owner/schedule mutation controls.
- The bit supplier has profile `{1:2401, 2:864, 3:475, 4:309, 5:152, 7:14, 8:9}`, prefix charge 256 bits, two-level coefficient charge 512 bits, and row coefficient 18,355 < 20,161.
- Two exact rational moment engines, both finite invoices, the bridge and all 47 strict outer inequalities pass; the next 10^-18 grid point is rejected.
- The independent audit reproduces the profiles, owner maps, invoices and strict assembly without importing producer or assembly code.

The package verifier regenerates the pinned PR #433 parent, all 2,918 Gaussian phase pairs and 240 endpoint adapters, then runs the twelve-reset constructor, independent reflected audit, changed global admission, and independent invoice/outer audit. The observed clean replay exited 0 in `/private/tmp/r746-release-replay-v3/VERIFICATION.json`. Run:

```sh
python3 -B research/early-reset-source-banks/verify.py --output /tmp/r746-full-replay
```

The vendored parent is pinned to PR #433 commit `2992f234bcb2538cb70f4d026aa8d08250b1040c`. Python 3.14+ is required for its frozen gzip byte pins; Python 3.11 emits the same decompressed content with a different gzip OS header. The package carries the parent licenses, notices, source hashes and explicit OpenAI Codex assistance disclosure. This remains a finite conditional construction retaining the inherited all-size compiler, arbitrary dirty-bank, compressed-window, restored-work, tape/common-grid, precision and analytic interfaces; it is not an unconditional theorem or Lean proof.
